title: Host diagnostic lines are written synchronously to stderr on async runtime workers
outcome: Bounded host diagnostic lines written from async request paths, such as the federation request deadline-expiry line and the federation link terminal line, go through a nonblocking sink. A stalled stderr can then never delay a request's reply or block a Tokio worker.
acceptance: Diagnostic lines emitted on async request paths in the federation listener and RPC code (FederationRequestLabel::expired, the link terminal line in fence_rpc_security_failure and observe_terminal_event, and others found by a sweep) are handed to a bounded nonblocking sink instead of a synchronous eprintln!. A behavioural test with a stalled sink shows the request's signed reply still returns by its deadline.
Line content, bounds and order are unchanged. No timeout or limit value changes. The review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
